content.short: Polygon Ventures is an investment fund dedicated to growing and supporting the blockchain ecosystem.
content.description: Polygon Ventures backs the development of decentralized applications on Ethereum and Polygon. As a venture capital fund, it provides funding to projects that build gaming, metaverse, and other Web3 applications utilizing blockchain infrastructure. By supporting teams on these networks, Polygon Ventures helps bring innovative, user-centric blockchain experiences to life. Eligible projects are invited to apply for funding.
